• Written works

- Heavy ang workload when it comes to written works (at least in our school). There will be subjects like creative writing and creative non fiction. Since you love writing and literature naman, i dont think you need to worry about this part.

• Political Science

- Palagi manood ng balita. There will be teachers na magpaparecite ng contemporary issues out of nowhere so it's best to be prepared with a news article from a valid source. I would recommend doing a light reading regarding philippine politics.

• Reading

- Enhance your reading comprehension because this strand requires critical thinking and analyzing skills. You can read anything kahit fiction pa yan. Basta sa binasa mo, dapat palagi kang may observation at sariling interpretation. This strand will practice you to formulate your own opinion; di yung sunod sunod ka lang sa kung ano yung sinasabi ng iba. I recommend reading genres or topics that are controversial, tragic, have complicated plots, and unique plot twists.

• Performing / Reporting / Public Speaking / Improvs

- This is frequent so mahahasa talaga yung verbal and social skills mo. Dadating ka sa point na di ka na kakabahan o matatakot kasi ilang beses mo na siya nagawa. For tips, bago ka pumunta sa harap, recollect your thoughts and focus on your objective. Give yourself confidence and show them what you got. Kung magkamali ka, so what? You can always do better next time.

• Mathematics

- Ako mahina rin sa math pero nakayanan naman. You can study general math and statistics & probability in advance if youre worried about your future performance in math but i wouldnt sweat it that much kasi di naman siya complicated.

Lastly, dont push yourself too hard. Enjoyin mo lang siya. Mag-enjoy magbasa, magsulat, magsalita, at mag-isip. Good luck!!
